propositions: CLI verb `rebar attach-commits <ticket> <sha>...` must validate all SHAs before recording any COMMITS event, rejecting the batch all-or-nothing if any SHA is invalid

DET path matching in close_precheck must union file_impact and commits discovery across the ticket and transitive descendants, blocking close if any changed path is neither declared in file_impact nor exempted by glob patterns (tests/**, docs/**, **/*.md, CHANGELOG.md)
MCP and library surfaces must inherit seam-level SHA validation so all three (CLI, library, MCP) enforce the same all-or-nothing contract

Merge commits must be skipped during path inspection to avoid false-pass on empty diff; source-(ii) local commits fail closed on git errors, while source-(i) foreign SHAs are skipped to avoid false-positive blocks
The glob_match helper with **/ semantics must be hoisted to commit_impact.py and shared by both prompts and registry modules, with oracle.py left unchanged as it uses plain fnmatch
